operationSets.name: TicketActions
operationSets.comment:
A ticket's status and timers operations (D103), for callers who hold
tickets.write; a reset or a snooze needs tickets.timers too, which the
core checks.

workers.name: TicketTimers
workers.comment:
Runs Ticket's deadlines as they fall due, and the writes of its rows that
Timers hears (D103): the worker
fixture-timers-api-ticket-timers.
